checkpoint_change.valid_default_path: For fresh CPU CLI processes with finite float32 state and default float32 dtype, validation reads tensors without mutating them or drawing RNG; explicit CPU/float32 construction selects the prior default device/dtype. Invalid or unsupported states now reject.

interpretation.exact_equal_results: Would establish equality for these specific saved arrays/checkpoint states under the checked configs and software, across the two observed host instances. It would not establish universal cross-CPU/platform bitwise reproducibility.
interpretation.non_equal_results: Report precise array/state and metric differences. Matching algorithm source and dependencies narrow possible causes, but this observation alone cannot assign all differences to CPU model: floating-point kernel dispatch, runtime/host state and any other uncontrolled environment differences remain factors.
interpretation.timing: Report each complete recorded command wall and internal timing scope as measured on that instance. CPU model differs and the current run shares resources with a two-thread SD workload; host load, frequency and filesystem/library caches are uncontrolled. Timings do not isolate a CPU-model or threading causal speedup.
interpretation.checkpoint_source_effect: The validated default numerical path is preserved by inspection; complete-command timing also includes the newly added save/load validation work, whose separate cost was not measured here.
